search.query: 2021-03-02 AI 新闻：先查 Google News，再核对 Microsoft News Center、Azure Blog、Ignite Book of News 与 TechCrunch 的原始页面

candidates.title: With Azure Percept, Microsoft adds new ways for customers to bring AI to the edge

evidence.claim: 微软新闻中心在 2021-03-02 记录 Azure Percept 进入公开预览，并说明硬件、Azure 服务与边缘 AI 场景。
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft unveiled the public preview of Azure Percept, a platform of hardware and services for using Azure AI technologies on the edge; the article gives voice, vision, device management, model development and analytics as parts of the platform.

evidence.claim: Azure 官方博客补充 Azure Percept 的设备、Studio、Azure AI/ML/IoT 集成与安全设计。
evidence.excerpt: Azure Percept is described as a single end-to-end platform integrating hardware accelerators with Azure AI and Azure IoT services; Percept Studio supports provisioning, model training and lifecycle management.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Ignite 官方 Book of News 将 Azure Percept 标为预览中的边缘设备与服务家族。
evidence.excerpt: Azure Percept is available in preview as a family of devices and services for real-time insights at the edge, with hardware accelerators, Azure AI and IoT services, and uses such as object detection, shelf analytics, anomaly detection and keyword spotting.

candidates.reason: 一手 Microsoft News Center 公告明确标注 2021-03-02，并由 Azure 官方博客与 Ignite 官方新闻册补充范围；新闻报道只作独立交叉核对。

candidates.title: Microsoft launches Azure Percept, its new hardware and software platform to bring AI to the edge

evidence.claim: TechCrunch 在同日独立报道 Azure Percept 的硬件、软件和边缘部署定位。
evidence.excerpt: TechCrunch reports the launch as a hardware and software platform combining Azure cloud tools with partner hardware, including a Vision development kit and a separate Audio device.

candidates.reason: 与 Microsoft 一手公告报道的是同一公开预览事件，保留为独立新闻交叉核对，不另起第二篇。

candidates.title: Azure Percept: Edge intelligence from silicon to service

evidence.claim: Azure 官方博客在 2021-03-02 解释 Azure Percept 的端到端平台设计。
evidence.excerpt: The post describes Percept Vision, Percept Audio, Percept Studio, Azure AI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure IoT and hardware-backed identity as parts of the announced platform.

candidates.reason: 同一 Microsoft 发布事件的一手技术说明，作为选中事件的支持来源，不重复写作。
